text: I highly recommend this clinic because the Doctor is expert especially in orthodontics. She is also kind and makes you feel comfortable and it is also good that she can speak English since I can't speak thai well. The staffs were very nice and accomodating. When you have questions or  having changes in your appointment they will reply to your message quickly. I have been consulting to another clinic before but they can't help me with my crooked teeth. Only Doctor An helps me and  gives assurance that she can fix my teeth. I am not wrong to choose this clinic since I'm with my 8th month of adjustment today and I can really see a big difference. Even with the first 2 months of adjustment I am happy that it went well. By the way I have crossbite and within 7 months Doctor An fixed it.

The clinic isn't big, but it's clean. I had a crown done, and the dentist did a great job. I also had scaling and fillings done. I used my social security benefits, so I didn't have to pay upfront, although there might be a small excess amount. The dentist is lovely and has a very gentle touch. I recommend calling to book an appointment beforehand. The clinic in Muang Thong Thani has really good prices.

This was my first time getting my teeth cleaned. The receptionist was very talkative, and I was very impressed with Dr. An and the team. They were very gentle and helpful. It was the best dental treatment I've ever had.

text: After getting braces for the second time, my teeth felt even more crooked and my mouth looked puffier. There was no attempt at correction; they remained silent and didn't respond. So I just paid to get it over with. I regret it to this day, having to spend money on braces again unnecessarily. The doctor was constantly chatting with the assistant, gossiping about other patients, criticizing (and criticizing) them all the time. They're really good at gossiping. It's exactly like the reviews I read. You should do your research thoroughly before getting braces.
The dentist was lovely and did a great job with the root canal treatment.
The doctor was very kind and straightened my teeth very quickly. He gave very good explanations.

My orthodontic treatment is complete. The dentist was lovely throughout. I traveled a long distance from Tha Nam Nonthaburi to see her because I had several molars extracted, and she corrected my crooked teeth and closed the gaps.

The dentist gave excellent advice. My front tooth was severely decayed, to the point where I thought it would be better to have it extracted. The dentist said it could be filled, but it had to be done slowly and carefully. In the end, I didn't need to have it extracted, and I even got a new tooth. I can smile brightly again and feel more confident than before.

I went for a filling, and now I feel like food particles are getting stuck more and I have a throbbing pain in that area. The next day, I tried to endure it by sleeping, but it didn't help. So I called to ask about checking in. They said the usual dentist wasn't in. If I wanted to consult another dentist, there would be a 100 baht charge, or I could stick with the original dentist, but it wouldn't be several days before he was back. T^T I thought this place would be good, but now I think next time I'll go to a clinic where the same dentist is always available, because I don't know what the outcome of the treatment will be.

The dentist is so lovely! The treatment was painless, even though I'm usually terrified of dentists. I'm afraid of anything related to my teeth, but since meeting this dentist, I've never been afraid to go to the dentist again. I'm also currently undergoing orthodontic treatment with the same dentist, and it's almost finished. The dentist is so kind!

text: Dr. An is lovely. She does dental work quickly, doesn't prolong treatment unnecessarily, and is very beautiful. She does an excellent job; all equipment is spotlessly clean and tidy, and the service is superb. Getting my retainers fitted was incredibly fast. Everything was perfect. I used to be afraid of dental work, but after seeing Dr. An, my fear is gone. I want to go back again and again. She's my number one dentist! 🥰 I'm not exaggerating, this is the genuine opinion.

text: I got braces from Dr. An to fix my protruding lip. The results are amazing! Even though I had a molar extracted, other places said I needed screws, but Dr. An said it wasn't necessary and I could still get braces. It's great because I don't have to go through the pain of repeated treatments. Now, my lips look beautiful just from straightening them! I highly recommend her.
The teeth straightened very quickly. It was a difficult case that other clinics wouldn't accept, but it was resolved here. The dentist is lovely and friendly.
